chapter: Hollywood, Ken Murray and the Penguin years
title: Billie Holiday at Mosley's Birdland birthday party
summary: A surprise party at Birdland where Billie Holiday sings; why John Hammond never booked him at Cafe Society.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Billie Holiday as the musicians knew her

blocks.x: That is only one of the things that hurt me, I was unable to do anything for Billie Holiday.
I forgot to tell you about the birthday party they gave to me at Birdland.

I was playing at the Sunnyside Horseshoe and Lois St. John, she was here not long ago, she manipulated the thing and they gave a surprise birthday party for me at Birdland and Billie Holiday, that was the last time I saw her alive. Billie came in and she looked so bad, but she came over to me and says, baby, I don't feel so good--she called everybody baby, I don't feel so good, but I'm going to sing for you and she got up and sang.
How well did you know her; had you known her that well?
I was thinking something; how come John Hammond never tried to get you in Cafe Society, or did he?
He never did. I can't understand why.

the kind of people that they had in there, they didn't have too--they had someone like Billie Holiday but they didn't have a band like yours. They didn't have a band that was entertaining as such; they had a band--Eddie Haywood's band played but they didn't do any singing or anything. They were a playing band.
Because for a long time he was in my corner. Later he got where he wasn't in my corner for some reason. He was a little strange.
